summary: Sampson County lookout tower; a CCC side camp in February 1940 was set up to build the towerman's residence and garage, and a four-room house was completed at the tower on April 29, 1940; the source gives no build date, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: The Camp designation conflicts inside one transcribed source: 'Side Camp P-68' in the February 6, 1940 entry and 'Camp S-68' for the April 29, 1940 house. Both are quoted in the story and it does not pick one. No source gives the tower's build date or type; the 1940 entries treat it as an existing lookout tower. No source covers fate, staffing or current condition. The cached NHLR North Carolina index (31 registered lookouts) does not list this tower. A search snippet mentioned a 'Firetower Road (SR-1119)' near DeVane's Farm Road in Sampson County, from a cemetery listing; it was not opened and is not used. Search results about a Williams Lake fire tower in British Columbia are a different place and were ignored. Access is not in any source, so no access fact is set.
